versions.content: Variant handling at runtime Status: DRAFT Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall provide API functions to allow applications to switch off configured diagnostic functionality for variant handling. Examples are diagnostic event or diagnostic test results (DTR). Rationale: Different market or regions require different sets of diagnostic functionality. Instead of a single software for each variant, a superset variant is created and the application can disable certain set of not desired functions. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: Support of a single software as superset of all needed diagnostics and disable at runtime the functionality that is not needed in a certain variant. The variant is mostly depending on the country or market the vehicle is homologated.
